# Comply with Data Security Regulations

Fortanix gives highly regulated industries and security-conscious organizations the controls to achieve, prove, and maintain compliance with the most stringent data privacy and security regulations.

[![Request a Demo](https://no-cache.hubspot.com/cta/default/3435228/b02137cd-d258-4121-ba58-7dd5c7369ed5.png)](https://cta-redirect.hubspot.com/cta/redirect/3435228/b02137cd-d258-4121-ba58-7dd5c7369ed5)

#### Data Security: The Cornerstone for   Governance, Risk, and Compliance.

Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is a core operational data strategy. It helps organizations align IT activities to business goals, proactively manage risk, and adhere to industry regulations or security frameworks. GRC provides the technical means to define and enforce data security and privacy policies, ensuring that personal and sensitive data is protected from unauthorized access and misuse.

#### How Fortanix Helps

![Search](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/solutions/use-case/regulatory-compliance/Search.svg)

###### Control Your Cryptographic Security Posture

- Discover keys and services across your on-prem and cloud silos
- Prevent data loss due to outdated algorithms or mismanaged keys
- Detect quantum-vulnerabilities and accelerate your PQC readiness journey
- Apply crypto-agility to ensure your encryption is set to the highest standards

[See Key Insight](https://www.fortanix.com/platform/data-security-manager/key-insight)

![encrypt compliance](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/solutions/use-case/regulatory-compliance/encrypt-compliance..svg)

###### Secure All Your Data

- Apply policy-driven encryption across hybrid-multicloud from a single console
- Secure data on files, disks, databases, or as it travels between applications
- Decrypt data in a confidential compute environment to protect it even while in-use

[See DSM](https://www.fortanix.com/platform/data-security-manager)

![key compliance](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/solutions/use-case/regulatory-compliance/key-compliance.svg)

###### Maintain Full Control Over Your Keys

- Govern consistent key access policies with federated identity, granular controls, and quorum approvals from a central console
- Bring your own key for any cloud and hold your own key within a geo boundary to support data sovereignty
- Securely store keys in next-gen FIPS 140-2 L3 HSMs, available on-prem or SaaS

[See DSM](https://www.fortanix.com/platform/data-security-manager)
